description: Defines interfaces and classes related to F1-C bearer handling in a 5G DU, including SDU handling, delivery notifications, and PDU processing.

classes.name: f1c_tx_sdu_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling SDUs pushed from lower layers towards the F1-C bearer.

classes.name: f1c_tx_delivery_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling notifications about transmitted and delivered PDCP PDUs.

classes.name: f1c_rx_pdu_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling received F1AP PDUs and related asynchronous operations.

classes.name: f1c_bearer
classes.description: Composite class inheriting all three handler interfaces, representing an F1-C bearer.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles SDUs pushed from lower layers into the F1-C bearer.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification
methods.description: Notifies the bearer of the highest transmitted PDCP PDU sequence number.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification
methods.description: Notifies the bearer of the highest successfully delivered PDCP PDU sequence number.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Handles incoming F1AP PDUs from the CU-CP.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_delivery
methods.description: Handles an F1AP PDU and awaits its delivery acknowledgment asynchronously.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_transmission
methods.description: Handles an F1AP PDU and awaits its transmission asynchronously.
